999008199.text: 翌日――

――はい！　今日の鍛錬はここまでにしましょう。
みんな、お疲れさま。いい汗かいたわね！

localizations.en: —Alright! That's enough training for today. Good work, everyone. You all worked up a great sweat!

999008199.text:
はぁっ、はぁ……疲れた……
ヤンネさんはまだまだ元気そうだね……

localizations.en: Hah... hah... I'm exhausted... You look like you could keep going all day, Janne...

999008199.text:
ええ。今日はいつも以上にやる気あるわよ。
あなたたちが用意してくれたごちそうのおかげかしら

localizations.en: That I could. I have more energy than usual today. Maybe it's thanks to that wonderful feast you all prepared.

999008199.text:
ごちそうで鍛錬から気を逸らさせる作戦は失敗ね……
むしろ、昨日よりキツい内容になってた気が

localizations.en: So the plan to distract her from training with food backfired... If anything, today's session was even harder than yesterday's.

999008199.text:
なのにヤドヴィガはけろっとしてるし、さすが九偉人。
……というか鍛錬中、一番生き生きしてたような

localizations.en: And Jadwiga didn't even break a sweat. Then again, she is one of the Miraculous Nine. ...Actually, she looked like she was having the time of her life out there.

999008199.text:
砂浜の性質を活かした良い鍛錬だった。
これが、休暇の過ごし方――

localizations.en: It was effective training that made good use of the beach terrain. So this is how one spends a vacation—

999008199.text:
さらに休暇を遂行する。
ヤンネ、続きを

localizations.en: I will continue vacation activities. Janne, please proceed.

999008199.text:
ちょっと待てーい！
なに追加しようとしてるんじゃい！

localizations.en: Hold on just a minute! What were you about to add?!

999008199.text:
ええ。過度な鍛錬はかえって身体に悪いわ。
九偉人のあなたなら問題ないのかもしれないけれど

localizations.en: She's right. Too much training can actually be hard on the body. Though that may not apply to one of the Miraculous Nine...

999008199.text: そうだけど、そういうことでもなーい！

いーい、ヤドヴィガ？
休暇の過ごし方っていうのは、もっと違うの！

localizations.en: Listen to me, Jadwiga. There's so much more to a vacation than this!

999008199.text:
まぁ、世界には休暇中も鍛錬をして過ごす人も
いるかもしれないけど、基本的には違うの！

localizations.en: Sure, some people out there spend their whole vacation training—but that's the exception, not the rule!

999008199.text: では、休暇中は何を？

localizations.en: Then what does one do during a vacation?

999008199.text:
ここみたいな行楽地に行って、綺麗な海で遊んだり、
ゆったりくつろいだり、美味しいものを食べたり……

localizations.en: You go to a resort like this one, play in the beautiful sea, relax and take it easy, eat all kinds of delicious food...

999008199.text:
そして、姉様がそんな休暇を満喫できるよう動くのが
私の休暇の使命

localizations.en: And for me personally, making sure Alvina gets to enjoy every bit of that is my own vacation mission.

999008199.text:
ただ今日はもう鍛錬で疲れて、遊ぶ元気はないし……
今から、これからの作戦を立てるよ！

localizations.en: But after all that training, I'm too wiped out to do anything fun right now... So let's sit down and plan out what to do next!

999008199.text: ヤドヴィガも協力してよね！

localizations.en: I'm counting on your help, Jadwiga!

999008199.text: しょ、承知
ふふ、ヤド姉、楽しそうだね

localizations.en: Hehe. Jad looks like she's having fun.

999008199.text: そうね。キューンも交ざってきてもいいのよ？

localizations.en: She does. You're welcome to join them, you know.

999008199.text:
あー、うん。今はいいかな。
私がいたら、いつものヤド姉になっちゃうと思うもん

localizations.en: Mm, I think I'll pass for now. If I'm there, she'll just go back to being the usual Jad.

999008199.text:
私たち兄弟以外と関わってるヤド姉がどんな感じか
ちょっと気になるからさ。今はいいの

localizations.en: I'm a little curious to see what she's like around people outside of us siblings. So... I'm good where I am.

999008199.text: そう、分かった

じゃあキューンは、ヴァレリアお姉ちゃんと一緒に、
美味しいものでも食べに行きましょうか！

localizations.en: Then how about you come along with me to find something good to eat?

999008199.text: うん！　行く行く！！
